title: Henri Funk
text:
I’m a PhD candidate at the Chair of Statistics, LMU Munich, working in cooperation with the group of Physical Geography and Complex Environmental Systems, and a member of the Statistical Consulting Unit (StaBLab).
My research combines statistical learning with environmental and climate data: multivariate bias correction of climate models, copula-based post-processing, and algorithm-agnostic interpretability for clustering.
